title: A Morning Thank You
hook: Before the day gets loud, take one breath and give thanks.

bible_verse.text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verification.note: Verse quoted from memory (KJV, public domain in the US). Check it against a reliable KJV edition before setting status to 'verified'.

prayer: Lord, thank you for this new morning: for the breath in my lungs, the light through the window, and the people you have placed in my life.
Forgive me for the days I rushed past your gifts and noticed only what was missing. Open my eyes to the small mercies: a kind word, a warm meal, a moment of quiet.
Let my gratitude become something I do, not just something I feel. Make me patient, generous, and present today. Amen.
closing: What is one thing you are thankful for today? Carry it with you.
description: A short prayer of gratitude to start your day. 🙏 Save it for the mornings you need the reminder.
